Bid Summary.value: The Dallas Independent School District is seeking proposals for student and staff computing devices, including laptops, desktops, tablets, and display monitors. The contract will last for three years with the possibility of two one-year extensions, totaling a maximum of five years. Vendors may submit proposals for one or multiple categories of devices, and the District may award contracts to one or multiple vendors. All questions regarding the proposal must be submitted by the specified deadline, and responses will be provided through an addendum.
